summary: The proposed addition is bounded to crates/domain/src/audit.rs, introduces only the read-only predicate has_valid_ingestion_correlation with the exact kind whitelist and correlation shape required, and does not alter constructors, persistence, emission or other event-family behavior. The existing tests are extended to cover the happy path, the recording guard, and the missing-token edge case, satisfying the stated acceptance examples HP-1, EC-1 and the scope guard.
